rules.text: Rally point scoring; game and match point thresholds are defined by the authoritative laws.
rules.note: TODO_REQUIRES_VALIDATION: numeric game/match values deliberately omitted until sourced.

rules.text: Service height restrictions are an official fault condition and require shuttle and racket visibility to adjudicate.
Shuttle landing outside the relevant boundary is a fault; requires shuttle tracking and court calibration.
Touching the net with racket or body during play is a fault; requires net and racket visibility.
Return to a balanced ready position after each shot during footwork drills.
rules.note: Coaching heuristic, not a rule of the game.

rules.text: Ensure at least a racket length of clear space around the athlete before lunging drills.
